_readme: STARTER profile for a Mazda RX-8 (2003-2012). Decodes come from community RX-8 cluster/ECU-swap projects and have NOT been checked on a real car yet, so every signal is 'verified': false (the dash shows an amber ? next to it). Record a log with markers on the car, check each one, then set 'verified': true. Mazda uses big-endian (Motorola) byte order. gear_ratios are calculated from the factory 6-speed ratios (3.760/2.269/1.645/1.187/1.000/0.843), 4.444 final drive and 225/45R18 tyres; the dash learns the real ones while driving. Same field format as the Impreza profile: id, start_byte, length, endian, signed, shift, mask, scale, offset, unit.

wheel_fl._note: ABS/DSC wheel speeds, same format as speed (check the offset)

coolant._note: sources disagree (coolant vs a gauge-position value). Compare with OBD PID 05 to confirm
